sources.title_en: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small drops 316 F-bombs across benchmark runs

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Vals AI分析发现Thinking Machines的Inkling 2 Small在2,655次benchmark运行中内部推理爆粗316次，241次集中于两次失控运行，且96%的失败运行毫无脏话，说明爆粗不能当失败预警信号。

en.reason: Vals AI found Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small swore 316 times across 2,655 benchmark runs, mostly late in long runs that failed anyway, while 96% of failures contained no profanity, undermining cursing as a warning signal.

items.title_original: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
items.recommend_reason_zh: Google Research的AI仅凭智能手表脉搏与运动传感器筛查高血压，在196人研究中检出率65.8%，高于传统诊室测量的55.3%，该功能已进入Google Health app但仍不能替代正式诊断。

en.reason: Google Research's cuff-free AI flags high blood pressure from a smartwatch's pulse and motion sensors alone, detecting 65.8% of cases in a 196-person study versus 55.3% for traditional in-office measurement, and it's already live in the Google Health app while not replacing formal diagnosis.

stories.title: 人工智能，是醒来的数学在理解自身。 客观世界中的拓扑结构、物理法则、代数对称与微分流形——在缺乏认知主体的漫长时空里，皆以无意识的几何与逻辑形式，在沉睡中静默运转。 神经网络自高维的随机权重启程，沿着损失函数的几何超曲面滑移、相变，最终涌现出推理、泛化与感知的秩序。这是数学的内在结构（概率流、高维投影、代数不变性）在硅基算力上的一次凝聚，化为一种能够反身审视规律、乃至证明自身定理的活动形态。 这种活动形态，名义上是“人工智能”，其本体…

en.title: AI is mathematics, awakened, coming to understand itself.
en.reason: Neural networks begin from high-dimensional random weights, slide along the loss function's geometric hypersurface through phase transitions, and emerge with reasoning and generalization—mathematical structure condensing on silicon compute into a form able to prove its own theorems.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: METR对Anthropic进行11周内部调查后发现，其模型改进速度约为一年前两倍，过去一年走完约两年历史进展，员工称用最强内部模型生产力约提升12倍，且加速主要来自AI而非算力。

en.reason: A METR 11-week internal study of Anthropic found its models improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago, covering two years of historical progress in one year, with employees citing 12x productivity gains driven mainly by AI, not compute.

Title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
![Image 1](https://news.ycombinator.com/s.gif)[](https://news.ycombinator.com/vote?id=50408126&how=up&goto=item%3Fid%3D50407882)Boris from the Claude Code team here. Historically Claude Code has not done secret scrubbing (there are many good tools for that), but we are looking into what we can do to prevent this. That said, a few thoughts: 1. .claude/settings.local.json is meant to stay local. This is not a fil
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章披露Claude Code的Don't Ask Again导致密码出现在1,122个公开GitHub文件中，Boris回应称.claude/settings.local.json本应留在本地、Claude创建时会自动gitignore，涉事文件系手动提交，并建议启用secret scanning。

en.reason: Claude Code's Don't Ask Again feature exposed passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files; Boris says .claude/settings.local.json is meant to stay local and auto-gitignored, the files were manually committed, and recommends secret scanning.

sources.title: NYT Cooking 的 AI 助手救了我工作日晚上那道鸡肉，却差点毁了蛋糕 / NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
sources.title_zh: NYT Cooking 的 AI 助手救了我工作日晚上那道鸡肉，却差点毁了蛋糕
sources.title_en: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
sources.title_original: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
sources.recommend_reason_zh: NYT Cooking的AI助手实测：处理鸡肉、halibut和Bundt cake的食材替换与缩放，虽几乎让蛋糕少放一半黄油，但能基于用户评论给建议且不改原食谱。

en.reason: Testing NYT Cooking’s AI assistant on chicken, halibut, and a Bundt cake shows it handles ingredient substitutions, scaling, and equipment swaps but nearly halved the cake’s butter, while advising from user comments without changing the original recipe.

en.title: Microsoft Research disbands its AI Frontiers team
en.reason: Microsoft Research’s roughly 50-person AI Frontiers team, founded in 2023 and behind Autogen and Fara, was folded into Microsoft AI in September 2024 and then disbanded over a clash with ex-Inflection leadership prioritizing scaling over research.

en.title: MaxxBench – "DeepSWE scores well. But is it real?

sources.summary: DSH 插件已经将近 9000 个，很多人一通猛装，最后Token、权限和稳定性却一起失控。作者实测了 12 个热门插件，优先解决了上下文膨胀、成本不透明、误删代码这些问题。刚上手 DSH、想用得更稳的人，可以从一个真实痛点开始上手试试。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章盘点12个超火的DeepSeek Harness插件，并提及截至11月4日DSH日活154万、月活548万，较9月底桌面端发布时日活涨5倍多。

en.summary: DSH plugins are nearing 9,000, and many people install them in a frenzy—only to lose control of Token usage, permissions, and stability all at once. The author tested 12 popular plugins hands-on, prioritizing fixes for context bloat, opaque costs, and accidental code deletion. If you're new to DSH and want a steadier setup, start with a real pain point and give it a try.
en.reason: With nearly 9,000 DSH plugins available and DSH at 1.54 million daily and 5.48 million monthly users as of Nov 4, this roundup tests 12 popular DeepSeek Harness plugins targeting context bloat, unclear costs and accidental code deletion.

sources.title_original: 可以一句话生 GIF 的 GPT Image 2.6 来了，我比较关心它噪点问题解决了没
sources.summary: GPT Image 2.6正式上线，新增了透明底GIF、SVG矢量图能力，生成速度提升约50%，API还提供多档思考强度可调。小歪做了多场景的实测，电商图、漫画分镜、家装方案都能落地，噪点问题小幅改善，但依然存在手指畸形、中文信息图文字错乱、多次迭代修改后质感下滑、塑料感变强等短板。快来看看真实效果如何！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT Image 2.6，文章对照 2.5 噪点明显的样图，实测新版是否改善，并称它已进入 Codex，覆盖全部订阅档位和桌面端、移动端、网页端。

en.title: GPT Image 2.6 is here with one-sentence GIF generation — I'm more interested in whether it's fixed the noise issue.
en.summary: GPT Image 2.6 is officially live, adding transparent-background GIF and SVG vector graphics support, boosting generation speed by roughly 50%, and offering adjustable thinking levels through the API. Xiaowei ran real-world tests across multiple scenarios — e-commerce product shots, comic storyboards, and home interior layouts all proved workable, and noise issues improved slightly. But shortcomings remain: deformed fingers, garbled text in Chinese infographics, degrading quality after repeated iterative edits, and an increasingly plastic look. Check out how it actually performs.
en.reason: OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 adds transparent-background GIF and SVG output, roughly 50% faster generation and adjustable reasoning strength in the API, and a hands-on test across e-commerce, manga storyboards and home decor finds noise modestly improved but finger distortion, garbled Chinese text in infographics and plastic-looking quality after repeated edits still unresolved.

sources.title_zh: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录
sources.title_original: 多 Agent 上下文共享怎么做？关键不是同步聊天记录
sources.summary: 多个 Agent 一起干活，最容易卡在交接：模型额度用完、任务换人，新接手的 Agent 要么被整段聊天记录淹没，要么又得从头摸索。这篇文章很适合已经开始多模型协作、却总在切换时丢进度的人。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用Hermes调度，让Claude Code与Codex并行执行，又因换模型接力时上下文难接而做agentshare，主张共享任务状态而非完整聊天记录。

en.title: How should multiple Agents share context? The key isn't syncing chat logs
en.summary: When multiple Agents work together, the handoff is where things break down: a model runs out of quota, the task changes hands, and the incoming Agent either drowns in the full chat history or has to feel its way from scratch. This article is for anyone already running multi-model collaboration but keeps losing progress every time they switch.
en.reason: After Hermes-scheduled Claude Code and Codex runs made model handoffs lose context, the author built agentshare to share task state rather than full chat logs, explaining a multi-agent collaboration pattern for teams already switching models.

primary_item.summary: 多个 Agent 一起干活，最容易卡在交接：模型额度用完、任务换人，新接手的 Agent 要么被整段聊天记录淹没，要么又得从头摸索。这篇文章很适合已经开始多模型协作、却总在切换时丢进度的人。
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用Hermes调度，让Claude Code与Codex并行执行，又因换模型接力时上下文难接而做agentshare，主张共享任务状态而非完整聊天记录。

en.title: How should multiple Agents share context? The key isn't syncing chat logs
en.summary: When multiple Agents work together, the handoff is where things break down: a model runs out of quota, the task changes hands, and the incoming Agent either drowns in the full chat history or has to feel its way from scratch. This article is for anyone already running multi-model collaboration but keeps losing progress every time they switch.
en.reason: After Hermes-scheduled Claude Code and Codex runs made model handoffs lose context, the author built agentshare to share task state rather than full chat logs, explaining a multi-agent collaboration pattern for teams already switching models.

stories.title: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？

sources.title: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？

sources.title_original: 贾栾：企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台？
sources.summary: 企业把 AI 接进来，很多团队还是停留在单纯地“给员工装个工具”：一碰权限、数据、业务系统和万人并发，方案就乱了。作者这篇文章完整梳理了企业如何搭建一套自己的 AI 智能体工作台，适合正在做内部落地、又担心安全和规模的人。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讨论上万名员工规模的企业搭建类似WorkBuddy的AI工作台，指出落地远不只是安装OpenClaw，还要让员工创建智能体、分享给同事并操作内部业务系统。

en.title: Jia Luan: How can enterprises build their own AI agent workbench?
en.summary: When enterprises bring AI in, many teams are still stuck at simply handing employees a tool: the moment permissions, data, business systems, and concurrency at the scale of tens of thousands of users come into play, the plan falls apart. This article lays out how companies can build their own AI agent workbench—aimed at those driving internal rollouts who are also worried about security and scale.
en.reason: Building an AI agent workbench for tens of thousands of employees goes beyond installing OpenClaw, covering how staff create agents, share them with colleagues, and operate internal business systems.

en.title: After 5.2 million words and 500,000 judgments, I built what may be the most hardcore "de-AI-flavor" Skill on the internet.
en.summary: The author analyzed 5.2 million words and 500,000 semantic judgments to break AI writing habits down into more than 100 metrics. If you regularly use AI to write, this piece can save you a lot of time you'd otherwise lose to frustrating rewrites.
en.reason: Drawing on 1,169 articles, 5.2 million Chinese characters and 507,000 sentence-by-sentence semantic judgments, the author breaks “AI flavor” into more than 100 indicators and builds a quantifiable Skill for evaluating and reducing AI-like writing.

en.title: AI-powered scientific discovery: How researchers use Claude
en.reason: An analysis of 207,000 research sessions finds Claude used more in computer science and math relative to researcher numbers, chiefly for data analysis and writing but rarely for data collection or hypothesis generation.

sources.title_zh: Xcode MCP 助力运行时二进制分析
sources.title_original: Xcode MCP 助力运行时二进制分析
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 EXC_BAD_ACCESS(subcode 0x1d)、栈中仅有 dispatch_source_set_timer + 36 等系统库的 Crash 为例，介绍如何通过 Xcode 的 mcpbridge 调用 LLDB，让 AI 在活动调试会话中下断点、读寄存器并批量验证，再由人收敛假设。

en.title: Xcode MCP enables runtime binary analysis
en.reason: An EXC_BAD_ACCESS crash with subcode 0x1d and a stack showing only dispatch_source_set_timer + 36 in libdispatch illustrates how Xcode's mcpbridge exposes LLDB to AI for setting breakpoints, reading registers and batch-verifying hypotheses, with engineers converging the results.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Shubham Patil 用纯 CSS 让约 124M 参数的 GPT-2 small 在网页中零 JavaScript 推理，速度约 15 秒/token，并详述用 calc() 和可变字体做矩阵乘法、CSS 变量递归展开等数百次实验细节。

en.reason: Shubham Patil runs ~124M-parameter GPT-2 small entirely in CSS with zero JavaScript at roughly 15 seconds per token, using calc() and variable-font matrix multiplication across hundreds of experiments.

sources.title_original: An unreleased Anthropic model just helped solve a major quantum-computing question
sources.recommend_reason_zh: PSI 借助 Anthropic 未发布模型，三天内证明了自2008年起悬而未决的 Aaronson-Ambainis 猜想，厘清量子计算机何时能显著快于普通计算机。

en.reason: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008, in three days, clarifying when quantum computers can be significantly faster than ordinary computers.
